# pidginhost_ssh_key (Data Source)

Looks up one SSH key stored on the account by id, alias or fingerprint. Set exactly one of them; the lookup fails when no key or more than one key matches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a key up by exactly one of id, alias or fingerprint.
data "pidginhost_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  alias = "laptop"
}

output "laptop_key_id" {
  value = data.pidginhost_ssh_key.laptop.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Alias of the key. Empty when the key has none.
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key, as the API reports it (SHA256:...).
- `id` (String) Id of the key.

### Read-Only

- `key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format.
